title: Hadith on Treating People by Their Status
summary: The hadith advises treating people according to their status.
translation: There is a hadith in Abu Dawood Sharif narrated by Maimoon ibn Abi Shabeeb, may Allah have mercy on him. He relates that a beggar came to Hazrat Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her). She gave him a piece of bread. Then another man passed by, dressed well and in good condition. She asked him to sit and eat. When asked why she did this, Hazrat Aisha replied, 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: ‘Assign people to their rightful status.’ This means to honor people according to their rank. Imam Abu Dawood notes that Maimoon did not meet Hazrat Aisha, but Imam Muslim mentioned this at the beginning of his Sahih as a commentary, stating that Hazrat Aisha shared that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) instructed us to recognize people's ranks. Therefore, this incident teaches us the importance of acknowledging and respecting individual statuses to maintain order. Mulla Ali Qari explains that even angels have specific positions as mentioned in the Quran, reinforcing this hadith. It emphasizes the balance required in assigning responsibilities and highlights the chaos that ensues when roles are given to unsuitable individuals, a reflection of the wise saying that the end times await when tasks are handled by the incompetent. This hadith prompts thoughtful consideration of societal roles and responsibilities.
